To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
mRNAs for IGFBP- 1 to 4, 5, and 6 are localized in different cell types in the rat kidney.
the mRNAs for all six IGF binding protein genes were expressed in rat kidney with a distinct pattern of expression for each gene.
the IGFBP family is differentially expressed in the renal tubules, glomeruli and interstitium.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of the insulin-like growth factors (IGFs) in kidney function, and in particular with the role of insulin-like growth factor I (IGF-I), a peptide growth factor that is present in kidney and has metabolic effects on renal function.
the regulation of growth and development in mammals.
the role of the IGF system in the development of the kidney.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
IGF-I is expressed in rat kidney and its activity is modulated in the kidney by IGFBP mRNAS.
IGF-I and the IGFBPs have multiple and distinct roles in kidney physiology.
the IGFBPs are present in all parts of the nephron and that the distribution is heterogeneous and site specific, with IGFBP- 5 being the most abundant.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
IGFBP- 1, -3, -5, and -6 mRNAs are expressed in the kidney and that IGFBP mRNA expression is not restricted to the epithelium.

IGFBP- 1 mRNA is found in the distal tubules, IGFBP- -2 in glomeruli and thin limbs of the Henle loop, IGFBP -3 in the interstitium, IGFBP 4 in the proximal nephron, IGFBP5 in the glomeruli, mesangium and distal tubules and IGFBP 6 in the interstitiun and ureter.
IGFBPs 1 to 5 are present in the nephron while IGFBP6 is present in the vascular system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
IGFBP mRNAS are differentially localized within the kidney, suggesting that IGFBPs may play a role in the regulation of IGF action in the kidney.
IGF binding proteins are expressed in the kidney and that their expression is not uniform.
the distribution of IGFBP mRNAS is very specific and that this may allow for the modulation of IGF activity in a site-specific fashion.
